manifest.name: INFER-µ
manifest.description: Evidence inference micronaut — evidence accumulation, confidence scoring, provenance tracking, truth-conditional verdict (Ch'en phase). proposal_only: emits typed verdict proposal; XCFE admits before execution.

infer.score.description: Yax/Ch'en-phase: score an evidence claim — assigns confidence weight based on source authority, field scope, and provenance chain depth.

infer.accumulate.description: Ch'en-phase: accumulate multiple scored evidence items into a weighted verdict — Bayesian combination of confidence scores, produces truth-conditional conclusion with uncertainty band.

infer.provenance.description: Ch'en-phase: verify provenance chain of an evidence item — checks authority claim, xcfe admission history, source micronaut, and phase at which evidence was produced.

infer.health.description: Pop-phase: reports evidence accumulation engine status, last verdict, confidence threshold.
